_comment: Compatibility layers downloadable from the in-app Compatibility Layers screen. Pulled from bannerhub-api GH Releases at runtime when the user taps Download. IDs are canonical (match upstream getContainerList / sp_winemu_all_containers space) so game launch configs referencing a given id resolve correctly post-install. The bundled proton10.0-x64-1 (id=10) is intentionally absent — it ships in the APK and never appears as downloadable.
_target_branch: BannerHub Nano Offline v0.2 — first Container Library release. See CONTAINER_LIBRARY_PLAN.md for the full design.
_sub_data_md5_note: For most entries sub_data.sub_file_name and sub_data.sub_file_md5 do NOT match. This is the documented steamuser/xuser md5-shape quirk (memory: project_bannerhub_api_proton_x64_subdata_fix). sub_file_md5 is what the app's install-time strict-check uses against the EXTRACTED wineprefix, not the binary checksum of the .tzst. Do not attempt to verify the downloaded .tzst against sub_file_md5. The wine archive's file_md5 IS the binary checksum — verify that on download.
